digest.component_or_area: code-review project criterion deployment and validation
propositions: The deployed Gerrit review bot must load and execute the review-phase-boundaries criterion through a live webhook-to-prompt-to-decision pipeline to validate end-to-end behavior without blocking production reviews

A four-patchset dogfood probe verifies that the project criterion produces an advisory finding with correct physical and logical identifiers, Pass-2 validity/impact/evidence observations, and Pass-3 priority/decision/threshold attributes when given a predeclared FIRE-control corpus sentence as stimulus
The positive-control patchset (discovery/evidence refinement) must produce zero project-attributed findings to establish that the criterion correctly abstains when the stimulus is phase-compliant

The historical severity-only patchset must remain unchanged in Gerrit and demonstrate that incomplete stimuli (missing instructed/owning phase names) cause abstention, distinguishing invalid input from criterion execution

The final submitted patchset removes the phase-violating FIRE directive, retains only the valid positive-control refinement, and must land on main with blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90 unchanged
A blocking promotion decision is deferred to a future separately-reviewed ticket backed by accumulated production review data; this story neither tunes the rubric nor enables blocking
